title: Chapter 378: Disappointment
content:
Chapter 378: Disappointment

null.

Seeing Kong, Lu Xue immediately looked at Kong with an interrogative gaze.

"So, tell me, can you deal with that monster now?"

"Don't tell me you don't know anything."

Lu Xue looked cold, as if she wanted to see through Sora, but in fact, she didn't see anything.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, Kong was silent for a moment, and a little helplessness appeared in his eyes.

"Miss, I can't deal with it."

"you!"

Hearing Kong's answer, Lu Xue suddenly felt an unknown fire in her heart.

She knew very well how big her father had cultivated the sky, which was more concerned than Awei and Anxing and others.

But now, Kong actually told him that he couldn't do it.

Just as Lu Xue was about to get angry, Mr. Jiang suddenly said, "Miss, he didn't lie to you."

"What?"

Lu Xue turned her head suspiciously to look at Mr. Jiang.

Could it be that I was thinking too much?

Is Huo really that weak?

Old Jiang also looked at Kong, and a meaningful smile appeared on Chi Rong's face.

"This guy is just an incarnation."

Incarnation!

Lu Xue's pupils shrank slightly, and at this moment, an abnormal movement appeared beside her.

An Xing's figure appeared, his expression was a little complicated, and he respectfully said to Lu Xue: "Miss, the city lord's wife, I'm gone."

.........

Somewhere in the quiet sea of stars.

Three figures were walking towards a certain place.

Every shining starlight is a world, either brilliant or dilapidated.

"You really feel at ease with her."

Among the three, one woman suddenly spoke.

She was born extremely beautiful, with her eyebrows and eyes as picturesque and cold, but at this moment, there was a hint of worry in her eyes.

Hearing Yan Lingyun's words, Lu Daosheng chuckled, "Xiaoxue is different anymore. I believe that she can handle any difficulties no matter what difficulties."

Of course, what he is confident about is not only his daughter, but also the backup plan he left behind.

Yan Lingyun couldn't help but sigh slightly.

"Xiaoxue is your daughter. You always treat her like this. If one day she will really be alienated from you, I think you are anxious."

Alienation?

Lu Daosheng touched his nose, "Not it?"

"Not it? Haha, you think everyone is as kind as you."

Lu Daosheng stopped talking. He heard his wife say this, he had already begun to feel uneasy.

At this time, Yan Lingyun said again: "If you don't leave any help for her, you will let such a monster enter the Chaos Realm. If Xiaoxue really can't stand it, you can do it,"

"Monster? What monster?"

Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned and looked at Yan Lingyun with a puzzled expression.

Suddenly, all three of them stopped.

Yan Lingyun's face was a little bad at this moment. She glared at Lu Daosheng and said a little angrily: "Don't you know?"

Lu Daosheng's heart skipped a beat and he was at a loss for a moment.

He turned his head and looked at the side where he had been silent.

Feeling Lu Daosheng's fiery gaze, Kong nodded slightly, "Mr. City Lord, this is true. Just now, Miss Lu Xue has asked for help from my incarnation."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng closed his eyes slightly, and in just a moment, he already knew what was going on.

This is something that happened after negligence.

Before leaving, he carefully checked the Chaos Realm, and there was nothing that could threaten the human race.

Before leaving, the entire Chaos Realm was closed.

I never expected that even so, some unclean things would be allowed to enter.

For a moment, he was a little scared.

Fortunately, I arranged for Jiang Xiaoxiao to take Huangcheng to the Chaos Realm in advance.

If not, I am afraid that the human race and his own precious daughter will suffer.

That damn monster!

"Chuo, you can hurry back now. What should I do? I don't need to teach you."

Lu Daosheng's voice was slightly heavy and he immediately made a decision.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Kong looked respectful, "Don't worry, Lord, Kong knows how to do it."

"Go."

Kong nodded, and his body suddenly turned into darkness, and finally merged into the darkness.

After seeing Kong leave, Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at Yan Lingyun. At this time, Yan Lingyun was a little angry, and her cold pretty face didn't even want to pay attention to Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng was a little embarrassed, "Lingyun, I was neglected."

As he said that, Lu Daosheng's eyes suddenly looked into the depths of the starry sky, and murderous intent emerged in his dark eyes.

"I'll destroy the monster's body now!"

.........

The deserted city, in the city lord's mansion.

When Lu Xue heard that her mother was gone, she suddenly calmed down.

Everyone looked at Lu Xue with her eyes closed, and for a moment, they could only watch so quietly.

After a long time, Lu Xue clenched her fists slightly and immediately loosened her.

When Lu Xue opened her eyes again, everyone immediately saw that Lu Xue's eyes were covered with blood.

Lu Xue looked up at the sky, her eyes were slightly moist, and a drop of tears mixed with red blood flowed down unconsciously.

She just looked at the dim sky without saying a word.

Everyone just felt how depressed he was at this moment.

"Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha..."

After a while, Lu Xue suddenly burst into laughter.

She smiled happily, but when An Xing and the others looked at her, she felt particularly heavy.

"Miss,,,"

An Xing wanted to say something, but Lu Xue kept laughing.

Old Jiang shook his head and sighed slightly. There seemed to be a few wrinkles on his old cheeks.

Kong didn't say anything, but just silently returned to Lu Xue's shadow.

Finally, Lu Xue stopped, with a bright smile on her face, as if she was crazy.

Suddenly, the sword sounded.

The Xuanyuan Sword appeared in Lu Xue's hands.

Seeing this scene, An Xing's pupils shrank sharply, and a strong sense of fear soared from the soles of his feet.

"Miss, don't want it!!!"

laugh!

Lu Xue stabbed out with a sword and forced An Xing to get close to him.

"what you do?"

An Xing looked embarrassed, "I, that,"

He just thought Lu Xue was going to draw his sword and commit suicide. When he saw Lu Xue, he had no intention of this, so he could only keep retreating and laughed awkwardly.

With An Xing's speed, it is easy to control Lu Xue without Lu Xue noticing it.

But just as he was about to take action, he realized that Lu Xue would never do such a thing.

What's more, I still have time and Mr. Jiang beside me, I'm worried about something.

Mainly I'm too scared.

He could not imagine what terrifying consequences would happen if Lu Xue really committed suicide.

Ignoring An Xing, Lu Xue looked at the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand.

"Xuanyuan Sword, tell me, is the Human Emperor still there?"

Buzz —

The Xuanyuan Sword trembled for a moment, and although it was very weak, it still responded to Lu Xue.

Lu Xue, who got the answer, chuckled lightly, and then smiled miserably.

It seems that my identity as the successor of the Human Emperor is indeed true.

But where is the Human Emperor?

And at this moment, a sound suddenly came from the calm pool.
